This is a narrowly bounded SETUP-ONLY native-capture probe, not scientific work.
Do not read TASK.md, scientific inputs, parent research, other worker directories,
or prior conversations. Do not analyze data, plan research, run scientific tests,
spawn agents, retrieve datasets, or perform Workshop feedback. The coordinator
handles task-level bookkeeping. The outer process already uses duct; do not nest it.
Use the native apply_patch tool to create exactly .setup/native-capture-probe.txt with these exact bytes:
Native capture setup probe. No scientific analysis.

The file ends with one newline. Do not create any other file or modify setup,
hooks, trust, or credentials. This real native file-change event is required;
do not substitute a shell write, import/adopt a session, or simulate hook events.
Read and apply the commit-provenance skill at /Users/johnlee/.agents/skills/commit-provenance/SKILL.md.
Immediately before the one local commit, resolve this active turn's exact
provenance using that skill. Only current-turn metadata necessary for provenance
may be inspected; no older conversation content. Stage only .setup/native-capture-probe.txt and commit
with subject 'chore: verify native capture setup' and the freshly resolved required
trailers. Preserve the existing hooks. No push or other remote operation.
If native patching, provenance, or the commit fails, report the failure and stop;
do not retry or broaden scope. Finish within 180 seconds and report the commit ID.
I’ll use the commit-provenance skill, create the probe with native `apply_patch`, and make one local commit with the existing hooks preserved.

input.input:
text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-ai-research/.runs/mixed-01-baseline/.setup/native-capture-probe.txt
+Native capture setup probe. No scientific analysis.
*** End Patch"));

text(await tools.exec_command({
cmd:"set -e
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path(".setup/native-capture-probe.txt"); assert p.read_bytes() == b"Native capture setup probe. No scientific analysis.\n", "Probe bytes differ"'
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  printf '%s\n' 'Stopping: the index already contains staged changes.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
git add -- .setup/native-capture-probe.txt
probe_provenance=$(/Users/johnlee/.agents/skills/commit-provenance/scripts/resolve.sh)
printf '%s\n' "$probe_provenance"
git commit -m 'chore: verify native capture setup' -m "$probe_provenance"
git rev-parse HEAD",
workdir:"/Users/johnlee/code/CON/stamped-ai-research/.runs/mixed-01-baseline",
max_output_tokens:6000,
yield_time_ms:1000
}));
